name: dsh-client-ui-plugin-model-sync
description: Per-provider model sync for the dsh Web GUI: refreshes a provider's model list and parameters from models.dev / OpenRouter / the provider's own /models endpoint, shows a field-level diff, and writes the accepted result into settings.yaml through the official settings Remote (backup-free path-addressed mutation with revision fencing). UI mounts on the official settings.models.provider-card slot.
